item.title: Villa Del Sol residents return to St. Lucie County condos after nearly 2 years of displacement
item.description: Residents of Villa Del Sol in St. Lucie County are returning home after nearly two years of being displaced from their condos following structural damage that forced evacuations in August 2024.

item.description: Three gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee, last month and qualified for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.title: Argentina defeats England 2-1 in World Cup semifinal after late rally
item.description: Argentina scored two goals in the final minutes to defeat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinal, advancing to the final against Spain on Sunday.

item.title: Spain advances to World Cup final with 2-0 victory over France
item.description: Spain will face either Argentina or England in the World Cup final Sunday after defeating France 2-0 in the semifinal on Tuesday.

item.title: Florida Panthers to open 2026-27 NHL season on four-game road trip starting with defending champion Carolina
item.description: The Panthers will begin their regular season on Sept. 29 against the 2026 Stanley Cup Champion Carolina Hurricanes before their home opener Oct. 11 against Minnesota Wild.

item.title: England and Argentina renew historic World Cup rivalry in semifinal
item.description: The two nations meet Wednesday in Atlanta with a spot in the World Cup final against Spain on the line, continuing a rivalry dating back to 1962.

item.title: Atlanta increases security for England-Argentina World Cup semifinal amid clash concerns
item.description: Police will increase personnel and resources for Wednesday's match after videos showed England and Argentina fans clashing in Miami over the weekend.

item.title: World Cup semifinals set with England, Argentina, France and Spain reaching final four
item.description: The four highest-ranked teams advanced to the semifinals after England and Argentina won quarterfinal matches over the weekend.

item.title: Palm Beach County Food Bank serves 2,500 hot meals daily to nearly 1,250 children through Summer BreakSpot program
item.description: The Palm Beach County Food Bank in Lake Worth Beach supports more than 35 Summer BreakSpot sites across Palm Beach County, serving approximately 2,500 hot meals each day to nearly 1,250 children.

item.description: The Ormond Beach-based insurer is reducing rates and launching a disappearing deductible program that rewards claims-free customers.
